other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), or Denotified Communities (DNC)
Applicant must be pursuing a 3-year undergraduate degree (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.)
Applicant must be enrolled in a Government or Government Aided Arts and Science College
benefits_summary: Full waiver of special, compulsory, and examination fees for eligible BC/MBC/DNC students in 3-year undergraduate programs at government or aided colleges.
